story.story:
Dawn light falls across Petal & Stem on Alder Street. Mara, wearing a green apron, unlocks the Petal & Stem door with a brass key and pushes it open. A brass doorbell gives a bright ring.

Inside Petal & Stem, quick close-ups follow Mara’s hands over a wooden counter. Mara gathers pink tulips and white daisies into a bouquet, folds cream paper around the stems, and ties a blue ribbon around the cream paper. Sunlight catches the petals as Mara lifts the bouquet from the wooden counter.

At the Petal & Stem door, Eli smiles. Mara places the bouquet into Eli’s waiting hands. Eli curls both hands around the cream paper, with the blue ribbon hanging over Eli’s fingers.

The camera draws back onto Alder Street. The final shot holds on the Petal & Stem shopfront in warm dawn light. Above the open Petal & Stem door, the shop sign reads: “Petal & Stem.”

beats.action: One uninterrupted, locked medium-close shot from just outside the threshold, angled toward the door lock and the shallow wooden counter immediately inside. Mara turns a brass key, pushes the door inward, and steps behind the counter; the brass bell rings. Keep the door open.

Mara gathers the small, loose cluster of pink tulips and white daisies lying on precreased cream paper. In one practiced sequence, she folds the paper around the stems and ties the blue ribbon with a simple snug knot, leaving two long tails. Her hands and the flowers dominate the foreground; dawn sunlight catches the petals.
Mara lifts the finished bouquet toward the open doorway. Eli steps into the right edge of the frame, smiling and raising both empty hands. End before the handover begins.

clips.prompt:
Widescreen 16:9 live-action photography with warm natural dawn light, tactile detail, gentle movement, and an intimate neighbourhood-ad feeling. 8 seconds, locked medium-close camera just outside the threshold, angled toward the lock and left counter. Petal & Stem on Alder Street matches @shop: sage-green timber frontage, cream fascia lettered exactly “Petal & Stem” in dark green, inward-opening glazed door, brass hardware and bell, shallow wooden counter immediately inside the left jamb. The finished Signature dawn bouquet matches @bouquet: pink tulips and white daisies, cream paper, blue ribbon with two long tails. Mara is dark-haired, in her thirties, wearing a moss-green apron over an ivory shirt with rolled sleeves. Eli is a short-haired adult in their thirties, wearing a pale-blue overshirt over a white T-shirt.
0–2 s: Door starts closed and locked. Mara turns a brass key, pushes the door inward and steps behind the nearby counter. One bright brass bell ring; door stays open.
2–7 s: Her hands and flowers dominate the foreground. She gathers the loose tulips and daisies resting on precreased cream paper, folds it around the stems and ties a snug simple blue-ribbon knot, leaving two long tails. Dawn light catches petals; illumination stays constant.
7–8 s: Mara lifts the finished bouquet upright to chest height toward the doorway, tails hanging. Eli enters only at the right edge, smiling, both empty hands raised. End before any touch or handover; bouquet stays in Mara’s hands.
Sound: quiet dawn birds, distant neighbourhood ambience, key click, bell, paper rustle, soft acoustic instrumental music.
one continuous shot, no cuts; no captions, subtitles or extra text; no speech of any kind; the same people throughout.
